title: Node kind → SKOS concept (glossary)
description: How scripts/glossary-export.ts writes a node kind (the schema a file is written against, such as `bean/1.0.0`) as a skos:Concept in the layer's glossary, with the kind's parents as skos:broader. Work item folio-assistant-dkqd (2026-11-04): so "Work item" reads as a narrower term of "Memory record", which is what `schemas/kg/memory-record.ts` says it is. The label is the kind's declared term, else its id read as words; the definition is its declared summary. The concept's IRI and @type stay in code. Its siblings are glossary-kind-concept (graph kinds) and glossary-harness-concept.

target.comment: The ledger key, `node-kind/<id>`: a code, unique in the scheme.
Prepared in code: the kind's id read as words and its `$schema` tag, minus the label, deduplicated and sorted, so the old name ("Bean") still finds the term.
The kind's declared parents, as the IRIs this table's concepts carry.
vocabulary-authority: skos:prefLabel is the fact, dcterms:title its derived copy (bean sl9u), as for roles.
